name: 24GB VRAM: Llama 3.1 8B Q8_0 decode tokens/sec
methodology: llama.cpp CUDA backend, batch size 1, 512 token prompt, 128 token output, Q8_0 quantization, 24GB VRAM (e.g., RTX 4090, RTX 3090)
notes: 24GB VRAM is the high-end consumer sweet spot. An 8B model at Q8_0 requires ~9GB, fitting with massive room for long context. A 13B model at Q8_0 requires ~15GB, also fitting. A 70B model at Q4_K_M requires ~35GB, which exceeds 24GB. 24GB is suitable for models up to ~13B at 8-bit or ~32B at 4-bit (with some CPU offload).
